title.en: Write the normal equations of a parabolic trend
Fit y = a + bX + cX² by least squares
Recognise when an exponential trend is suitable

say.en: Mobile data use in India did not grow by the same amount each year: it grew faster and faster. A straight line cannot follow it; a parabola can. In this lesson: Write the normal equations of a parabolic trend.
Fit y equals a plus bX plus cX squared by least squares.
Recognise when an exponential trend is suitable.

body.en: For $y = a + bX + cX^2$, least squares gives three normal equations. With the origin at the middle year, $\sum X = \sum X^3 = 0$, and they reduce to $\sum y = na + c\sum X^2$, $\sum Xy = b\sum X^2$, $\sum X^2 y = a\sum X^2 + c\sum X^4$. Solve the first and third together for a and c; b comes directly from the second.

points.en: Solve Σy = na + cΣX² and ΣX²y = aΣX² + cΣX⁴

narration.en: For a parabolic trend the three normal equations, with the origin at the middle, give b directly, and a and c from two simultaneous equations.

body.en: If a series grows at a roughly constant rate (like compound interest), fit $y = ab^X$. Taking logarithms, $\log y = \log a + X\log b$, a straight line in X. Fit it by least squares to $(X, \log y)$: $\log a = \frac{\sum \log y}{n}$, $\log b = \frac{\sum X\log y}{\sum X^2}$, then take antilogs.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Fit a parabolic trend y = a + bX + cX² to the values 10, 13, 15, 23, 30 for 2020–2024 and estimate the trend for 2025.

say.en: Let us work this out together. Fit a parabolic trend y equals a plus bX plus cX squared to the values 10, 13, 15, 23, 30 for 2020-2024 and estimate the trend for 2025.
Origin 2022: X equals minus 2, minus 1, 0, 1, 2. ΣX squared equals 10, ΣX to the power 4 equals 34.
Σy equals 91, ΣXy equals 50, ΣX squaredy equals 196. So b equals 50 over 10 equals 5.
91 equals 5a plus 10c and 196 equals 10a plus 34c so 14c equals 14, c equals 1; a equals 91 minus 10c/5 equals 16.2.
2025: X equals 3, y equals 16.2 plus 53 plus 19 equals 40.2.
So the answer is y equals 16.2 plus 5X plus X squared; 2025 estimate 40.2.
